item.isekai_mahou.home_key.desc: Use it to claim your home: an island of your own in another dimension, with a small house ready.
item.isekai_mahou.home_key.desc2: After that, press the Home key (or open the menu) once you have been out of combat for 2 min.
toast.isekai_mahou.home_realm.unlocked_s: An island of your own awaits.
hint.isekai_mahou.home_realm_unlocked: Your Home is ready: press %s (or menu B → Travel Guide → Home) once you have been out of combat for 2 min.
hint.isekai_mahou.home_realm_arrived: Nothing can hurt you here. Build freely and invite friends in menu B → Home. The same key takes you back.
hint.isekai_mahou.home_realm_invited: You were invited to a Home: visit it in menu B → Travel Guide → Home.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.no_: The Home Dimension is not available in this world.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.alr: You already have a Home. Keep the key for a friend.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.spe: You cannot go Home right now.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.spi: Souls cannot find the way home. Recover your body first.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.not: You cannot go Home from here. Finish what you started.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.bos: You are in a boss fight: you cannot go Home.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.com: In combat: you can go Home in %s.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.not: You do not have a Home yet. The Home Key is sold at inns.
You were not invited to that Home.
You are not in the Home Dimension.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.inv: You can only invite players who are online.
Your Home already has %s guests. Remove someone first.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.arr: Stand on the ground of your own Home to set the arrival point.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.deny.not: Only the owner (or whoever they allow) can change things here.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.evacuate: You cannot stay here: returning to where you were.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.invite_r: %s invited you to their Home! Visit it in menu B → Travel Guide → Home.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.guests_b: Guests can now build and open chests in your Home.
Guests can only look: they cannot change anything.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.sleep_no: You rest, but the night does not pass: people are awake outside.
message.isekai_mahou.home_realm.void_res: Your Home will not let you fall.
command.isekai_mahou.home_realm.combat: In combat for %s more s (to enter the Home).
screen.isekai_mahou.home_realm.title: Home
screen.isekai_mahou.home_realm.not_owned: You do not have a Home yet.
screen.isekai_mahou.home_realm.desc: You can only go after 2 min out of combat. Inside nothing hurts you, there are no monsters, and chests and beds work. When you leave you return exactly to where you were.
screen.isekai_mahou.home_realm.how_to: The Home Key is sold (at a high price) by city innkeepers. Use the key to claim an island of your own, with a small house ready and room to build.
guide.isekai_mahou.portals.home_realm.ho: No portal: buy the Home Key at an inn (very expensive) and use it. After that, press the Home key or use menu B (Travel Guide → Home) once you have been out of combat for 2 min. It is safe there, you can build and invite friends; when you leave you return to where you were.
